instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Managed IT services provider offering helpdesk, network management, cybersecurity monitoring, and cloud migration services to 150+ SME clients. 24/7 NOC with 18 technicians. Currently developing a self-service client portal for ticket tracking and automated health reporting. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth. We see untapped demand in adjacent customer segments and are evaluating whether to build, buy, or partner to accelerate market penetration. The core question is whether to deepen our vertical specialization or broaden horizontally into related product categories.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

input.changes_since_last: Regulatory changes forced compliance reviews. 6 new standard procedures implemented. Team morale improving.

opportunities.title: Formalize Innovation Scaling and Governance (Carry-Forward)
opportunities.rationale: The company has demonstrated successful product line growth (4 SKUs, 18% revenue) but the innovation function remains informal and lacks dedicated budget/governance structure. Scaling requires migrating decision authority from a single owner to a structured program office.

first_actions: Establish an Innovation Review Board (IRB) with cross-functional stakeholders, mandatory for all new initiatives beyond concept phase.
Integrate compliance checkpoints into the stage-gate process, specifically addressing the 6 newly implemented standard procedures.
Develop a clear governance matrix defining roles and decision rights to decentralize ownership away from the primary owner.
execution_plan.success_metric: IRB approval rate and reduction in ad-hoc decision-making incidents by 30%.
milestones: Pilot IRB session completed for a new product line.
Training rolled out to core stakeholders.

opportunities.title: Strategic Market Expansion Assessment (Build/Buy/Partner)
opportunities.rationale: With a 30% growth target and high competitive pressure, the organization needs a structured approach to determine if horizontal expansion requires organic build-out or external capability acquisition. This minimizes risk while rapidly accessing adjacent market segments.

first_actions: Conduct a comprehensive SWOT analysis focused on 2-3 high-potential, unaddressed vertical markets.
Identify potential small M&A targets (under $5M revenue) or strategic technology partners to model rapid entry into target segments.
Develop financial models comparing the cost/time of 'Build' vs. 'Acquire' for core market capability.
Conduct GDPR and data privacy compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: CFO oversight and dedicated capital allocation modeling time
Legal counsel specializing in M&A due diligence
execution_plan.success_metric: Creation of a prioritized Go-To-Market Strategy document with clear Build/Buy/Partner recommendations for the next fiscal year.
milestones: Shortlist of 3 target segments and corresponding acquisition models.
Executive presentation detailing market entry recommendation.

next_steps.action: Host a dedicated cross-departmental governance workshop to draft the charter for the Innovation Review Board (IRB) and formalize decision gates.
Conduct a gap analysis audit between the 6 new standard procedures and current operations to identify any systemic process bypasses or undocumented manual workarounds.
Formalize and ring-fence a dedicated, recurring innovation budget of $X (calculated based on the 5% revenue benchmark) to remove reliance on ad-hoc funding.

key_weaknesses: Structural dependence on single decision points (Owner Alone), creating a critical bottleneck for scaling.
Under-resourcing of innovation capability due to lack of dedicated, protected budget and formal function status.
System integration remains ad-hoc despite having multiple developed tools, indicating poor overarching IT governance.

improvements: Increased operational compliance maturity through the implementation of 6 new standard procedures (addressing high regulatory risk).
Demonstrated consistent product growth capability with 4 new lines contributing 18% of revenue.
Development of self-service client portals and foundational digital tools.
persistent_gaps: Formal corporate governance structure for innovation remains underdeveloped, relying on informal advocates.
The decision-making process is bottlenecked by single ownership, preventing rapid, decentralized scaling.
Lack of formalized IT system integration layer results in operational inefficiency and manual data transfer.
achieved_milestones: Successfully established 4 new revenue streams; Self-service client portal development initiated.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Increased regulatory compliance and product revenue streams show improvement (High -> Medium/High). However, structural weaknesses in governance and decision making are persistent or regressed.
